turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Hello, how may I help you today?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: I'm having a lot of trouble on the website. It is loading really slowly.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Sure, I've already processed a refund for your last order. Let me confirm the amount: $49.99.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Really? Thanks!

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: I am very sorry to hear that, let's see what we can do to fix this.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Thanks. I can't even see pictures because they are still loading

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: If you don't mind, let's try a couple things and see if we can get this fixed for you.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: that sounds good

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Have you tried looking at other websites to see if they are slow as well?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: I'll check

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: google is loading fine

turns.speaker: system
turns.text: Agent is looking for solutions ...

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: No problem so it isn't your internet connection. Let's try the most common solution which has to do with cookies, try logging completely out then logging back in.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: okay

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Usually it is a corrupted cookie and after a complete relog it corrects itself.

turns.speaker: system
turns.text: Agent is looking for solutions ...

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: It's still taking forever. Should I close the browser after I log out?

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Yes the last step would be closing all tabs besides this one on your browser and trying again.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: hold on

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Also if you have too many programs in the background it slows things down too.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: gotcha

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: so I think it's working nnow

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Still do the logout then log in.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: yes everything loaded

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Ah fantastic, I was just trying to save the current tabs you were on before we had to close them.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Apologies for the trouble.

turns.speaker: system
turns.text: Agent is looking for solutions ...

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: That's okay I'm just glad to be able to use the site

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Thank you

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: My pleasure, is there anything else I can help you with today?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Not right now. Thanks again

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Thank you for your patronage and have a wonderful rest of your day!
